name: Cook
job_description:
Sage Crossing Retirement Community in Gilbert, AZ is hiring a Cook to join our dining services team.

Responsibilities

  • Prepares resident meals according to planned menus and dietary needs.
  • Maintains a clean, sanitary kitchen that follows all food-safety standards.
  • Assists with weekly inventory counts and food ordering.

Qualifications

  • Previous cooking experience in a senior living or healthcare setting preferred.
  • A food handler certification, or a willingness to obtian one within 30 days of hire.

name: Resident Care Aide
job_description:
Willow Bend Senior Living is a large senior living community in Fort Collins, CO seeking a compassionate Resident Care Aide.

"Our highest aim is to do and be the best in all we undertake, and to provide a Cedarline life for every resident, their families and our employees." — Marian Ellsworth, CEO

About Marigold Court

Marigold Court has proudly served local families for over a decade with warmth and dignity.

What We Offer
